name: Shay Boloor
zh_summary: $ORCL just laid out a path to $225B in revenue by FY2030 which would triple its business in 4 years. Even more interesting is that Oracle expects its growth to be self-funded by FY2029 which could ease concerns about how much debt it needs to finance its massive AI buildout.

text:
